d:
Chirag Paswan Big Statement : vaishali men nitish setu ke lokarpan ke bad kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne ise apne divangat pita ramvilas pasvan ke sansdiy kshetr ki varshon purani mang bataya. chirag ne kaha ki vaishali ki janta lanbe samay se is pul ki mang kar rahi thi. pradhanmantri narendr modi aur purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ne milkar is sapne ko sakar kiya hai.
Chirag pasvan ne is mauke par apne pita ke sansdiy kshetr aur vahan ke logon ki purani mang ka jikr kiya. aakhir is pul se vaishali aur aaspas ke logon ko kya phayda milega? dekhie puri riporta.
